verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing describes a built-in AI layer, Clara Intelligence, with an "automated CFO agent" and an "AI partner" Financial Analyst that delivers spend insights. That is direct but thin support for an in-product assistant. Clara MCP is a server for external AI assistants, not a built-in one, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documentation of what tasks users can delegate to the in-product agent, how they interact with it (chat or commands), whether it can take actions beyond producing insights, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Clara Intelligence: Put AI to work with an automated CFO agent and predictive insights.
Your AI partner delivers the insights you need before issues escalate.
